ranked_fix_hypotheses.paired_evidence: Use the saved direct model decline text and verifier checks per item, and compare matching full/fast contexts and verdicts without attributing changes to the verifier.

held_out_validation_plan: Obtain owner approval before any code, dependency or tuning change; reserve separately authored, independently reviewed questions and a fixed frozen corpus; avoid training or choosing on golden_v1 and its fast subset.

Pre-register one candidate per knob and hold router outputs, filters, retrieval query, corpus and hardware fixed when measuring a single factor; store per-query branch depths, scores, fallback and input order for paired comparisons, including changed-k retrieval rather than slicing a smaller list.

Measure complete-set Sufficiency@10 by source and type, over-abstention among answerables, false-answer rate among unanswerables, faithfulness, numeric accuracy and answer correctness, plus latency, timeout and cost; report paired gains and losses and uncertainty with repeated runs.

Only after selection on development data evaluate once on held-out full and fast slices; guard adverse handwritten and seeded outcomes, F-110 lexical overlap and F-103 authorship caveats; never tune the gate thresholds to these results.
